If truthy and targetLeft/targetWidth differ, beginAnimation(arg1) only when targetLeft differs, then setLeftRight(0,0,sum,sum+width) and cache both target fields; accumulate the custom width even when cached targets already match. After the custom branch always read getWidth into f17_local2 but never use that value for accumulation. Finally set container width to the sum. No normal getWidth fallback layout/accumulation is recovered; preserve that literal defect. Store exact global CoD.FreeCursorUtility.GetWidthByVisibleChildrenWidth into arg0.
